# SparkReceipt

> > AI-powered receipt scanner and expense tracker that automates tax preparation and financial management for small businesses and freelancers.

SparkReceipt is a comprehensive expense management platform that uses OCR and AI to automatically scan, categorize, and organize receipts for tax compliance. It serves freelancers, small business owners, and various industries with integrated tools for expense tracking, income management, and financial reporting.

## Key Topics

- AI Receipt Scanning
- Expense Tracking
- Tax Preparation
- OCR Technology
- Freelancer Tools
- Small Business Accounting
- Receipt Organization
- Bank Statement Extraction
- Multi-Currency Support
- PDF/CSV/Excel Export
- Gmail Integration
- Mileage Tracking
- Invoice Processing
- IRS Compliance
- Pre-Accounting Automation

## Core Features

- [Receipt Scanner App for Small Business](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/receipt-scanner): AI-powered receipt scanner with auto-categorization and tax-ready reports.
- [Expense Tracker For Small Business & Freelancers](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/expense-tracker): AI expense tracker with receipt scanning and tax-ready report generation.
- [Receipt Tracker for Taxes](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/receipt-tracker-for-taxes): IRS-compliant receipt tracker with AI scanning and expense categorization.
- [Receipt Organizer for Small Business](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/receipt-organizer): AI-powered receipt organizer with auto-categorization for freelancers.
- [Income Tracker for Freelancers & Small Business](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/income-tracker): AI income tracker with invoice scanning and multi-currency support.
- [Bank Statement Extractor](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/bank-statement-extractor): AI extracts bank transactions from PDF/CSV/Excel and matches receipts.

## Advanced Tools & Integrations

- [Fetch Email Receipts Automatically from Gmail](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/email-receipts): Gmail integration to automatically fetch and categorize email receipts.
- [Credit Card Receipt Scanner & Organizer App](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/credit-card-receipts): AI receipt scanner for credit card expense organization and IRS compliance.
- [Mileage Tracker With Receipt Scanning & Expenses](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/mileage-tracker): GPS mileage tracker integrated with receipt scanning and expense tracking.
- [Pre-Accounting Software for Small Business](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/pre-accounting): AI-powered pre-accounting software for receipt and expense automation.
- [Expense Reports for Freelancers & Small Business](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/expense-reports): Generate expense reports in PDF or Excel from AI-scanned receipts.
- [Export Your Receipts in CSV, PDF, Excel or ZIP](https://sparkreceipt.com/features/exports): Export receipts and expense data in CSV, PDF, Excel, or ZIP formats.
